sentences.l1: Many people take the bus to work.

sentences.l2: 这样，路上的汽车就少了。
sentences.l1: In this way, there are fewer cars on the road.
With fewer cars, the air is clean.

sentences.l2: 空气干净，我们就更健康。
sentences.l1: When the air is clean, we are healthier.

sentences.l2: 走路或骑自行车去工作也是好办法。
sentences.l1: Walking or riding a bicycle to work is also a good way.

sentences.l2: 这些方法可以减少污染。
污染少了，地球会更美丽。
sentences.l1: With less pollution, the earth will be more beautiful.

sentences.l2: 我们把这种行为叫环保。
sentences.l1: We call this kind of behavior environmental protection.

sentences.l2: 每天通勤的时候，如果大家选择公共交通，每个人的碳足迹就会变小。
sentences.l1: When commuting every day, if everyone chooses public transport, each person's carbon footprint will become smaller.

sentences.l2: 碳足迹小，地球的负担就轻。
sentences.l1: When the carbon footprint is small, the earth's burden is light.

sentences.l2: 城市规划者希望修更多的地铁和车站。
sentences.l1: City planners hope to build more subways and stations.

sentences.l2: 这样，人们更愿意坐地铁。
sentences.l1: In this way, people are more willing to take the subway.
The subway is fast and has no traffic jams either.

sentences.l2: 住在城市里的人多，大家一起努力，可以让城市变得更好。
sentences.l1: With many people living in the city, if everyone works together, they can make the city better.
